data.name: Create Issue
data.evaluateGuide:
Creates a new Jira issue from a supplied payload, enabling an agent to file work items in an Atlassian project.
Use for: filing a ticket, creating a task, logging an incident
Not supported: retrieving, updating, deleting, or notifying issues

data.name: Jira - Get Issue
data.description:
Retrieves a Jira issue by its issue key.
Documentation: https://help.smartling.com/hc/en-us/articles/25306050598299-Setting-Up-Smartling-Issue-Management-for-Jira
Quick Start:
- Call this endpoint with the issue key (e.g., PROJECT-123) using the integration credentials.
Parameters Explained:
- issueKey (required, path): The Jira issue key, e.g., PROJECT-123.
- Optional query parameters (not documented here) may include fields to limit returned fields.
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 404 Not Found: Issue key invalid or integration user lacks Browse Projects permission.
- 401 Unauthorized: Bad credentials.
Edge Cases:
- If requestor lacks permission to view certain fields, those fields will be omitted from the response.
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- Subject to Jira rate limits.
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves a Jira issue using its issue key and returns its available details.
Use for: viewing an issue, checking ticket details, inspecting issue fields
Not supported: creating, editing, deleting, or notifying issues

data.name: Send notification for issue
data.description:
Creates an email notification for an issue and adds it to the mail queue.
Permissions required:

Browse Projects project permission for the project that the issue is in.
If issue-level security is configured, issue-level security permission to view the issue.
data.evaluateGuide:
Adds an email notification for a Jira issue to the mail queue, allowing an agent to alert specified recipients.
Use for: notifying issue watchers, emailing stakeholders, alerting collaborators
Not supported: creating, retrieving, editing, or deleting issues

data.name: Jira - Delete Issue
data.description:
Deletes the specified Jira issue by issue key.
Documentation: https://help.smartling.com/hc/en-us/articles/25306050598299-Setting-Up-Smartling-Issue-Management-for-Jira
Quick Start:
- Ensure the integration user has Delete Own/Delete All permission as applicable and call DELETE with the issue key.
Parameters Explained:
- issueKey (required, path): The Jira issue key to delete.
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 404 Not Found: Issue does not exist or user lacks permission.
- 401/403: Authentication/permission issues.
Edge Cases:
- Deleting an issue is irreversible unless your Jira instance has restore functionality; Smartling first recommends notifying Smartling support before removing integration.
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- Subject to Jira rate limits and project policies.
data.evaluateGuide:
Permanently deletes a Jira issue identified by its issue key.
Use for: removing an issue, deleting obsolete tickets, cleaning up test issues
Not supported: restoring, retrieving, editing, or creating issues

data.name: Create issue type
data.description:
Creates an issue type and adds it to the default issue type scheme.
Permissions required: Administer Jira global permission.
data.evaluateGuide:
Creates a Jira issue type and adds it to the default issue type scheme for administrators.
Use for: adding an issue type, defining a work category, configuring Jira types
Not supported: editing existing types, listing types, creating issues

data.name: Jira - Update Issue
data.description:
Updates an existing Jira issue by issue key.
Documentation: https://help.smartling.com/hc/en-us/articles/25306050598299-Setting-Up-Smartling-Issue-Management-for-Jira
Quick Start:
- Use PUT with the issue key in the path and provide fields with values to update.
Parameters Explained:
- issueKey (required, path): The Jira issue key to update.
- Request body should include fields with the fields to change.
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 400 Bad Request: Invalid field data.
- 404 Not Found: Issue key not found.
- 401 Unauthorized / 403 Forbidden: Authentication/permission issues.
Edge Cases:
- Partial updates are supported; provide only fields that need changing.
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- Subject to Jira rate limits and project validations.
data.evaluateGuide:
Updates an existing Jira issue using its issue key and supplied field values.
Use for: changing ticket fields, editing a task, revising issue details
Not supported: creating, retrieving, deleting, or notifying issues

data.name: Jira - Get Issue Types
data.description:
Retrieves the list of issue types available in Jira for the authenticated context.
Documentation: https://help.smartling.com/hc/en-us/articles/25306050598299-Setting-Up-Smartling-Issue-Management-for-Jira
Quick Start:
- Ensure your integration user PAT is available and has the Browse Projects permission.
- Call the endpoint to list available issue types.
Parameters Explained:
- No path or query parameters for this endpoint. It returns global issue types visible to the user.
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 401 Unauthorized: Invalid or missing credentials for the Jira API. Provide a valid PAT.
- 403 Forbidden: Integration user lacks Browse Projects permission.
Edge Cases:
- Returned issue types may be filtered by project-specific configurations; some types might not be available in all projects.
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- Jira Cloud rate limits apply (not specified in this Smartling doc). Check your Jira instance or Atlassian documentation.
data.evaluateGuide:
Lists the Jira issue types available to the authenticated context.
Use for: listing issue types, finding valid type identifiers, inspecting Jira configuration
Not supported: creating, editing, deleting, or retrieving individual issues

data.name: Jira - Create Issue
data.description:
Creates a new issue in Jira (used by the Smartling integration to create SOURCE/TRANSLATION issues).
Documentation: https://help.smartling.com/hc/en-us/articles/25306050598299-Setting-Up-Smartling-Issue-Management-for-Jira
Quick Start:
- Ensure integration user has Create Issues permission.
- POST a minimal issue JSON with project.key, summary, and issuetype.id or issuetype.name.
Parameters Explained:
- Request body must include fields object containing at least:
  - project: { "key": "PROJECT" }
  - summary: string
  - issuetype: { "id": "1" } or { "name": "Task" }
- Additional fields may be included (e.g., description, custom fields).
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 400 Bad Request: Missing required fields or invalid field formats.
- 403 Forbidden: Integration user lacks Create Issues permission.
- 401 Unauthorized: Invalid credentials.
Edge Cases:
- If Jira has required custom fields not provided, creation will fail; include required fields with default values.
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- Subject to Jira rate limits and project-specific validations.
data.evaluateGuide:
Creates a new Jira issue from project, summary, and issue-type details, supporting integration-created work items.
Use for: creating a source issue, creating a translation issue, filing a Jira ticket
Not supported: retrieving, editing, deleting, or notifying issues
